items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: that orchestra was under the direction of Buzz Meredith, who happened to be Burgess Meredith's brother.

ctx.x: I see. And so that was your beginning in the professional music business.

Yeah. I later played in another band on the Pennland (PHONETIC) -- the Republic was the United States Line, and the Pennland was the Red Star Line, and that orchestra was under the direction of Buzz Meredith, who happened to be Burgess Meredith's brother.
